purpose: Improve the unchanged monthly CSI300 research framework; keep every trial and separate selection from final evaluation
prior_period_use: User confirmed 2021-2026 had not been used to adjust factors, models or parameters; original 2017-2020 results are development evidence
selection_rule: Highest validation annualized information ratio after modeled costs; prefer drawdown >= -40%; ties break on lower turnover then candidate id. Never select on final results.
final_test_policy: Evaluate only the frozen selected candidate and predeclared baselines once; no parameter changes after opening final results. Monthly refitting on then-mature historical labels is part of the frozen algorithm.
execution_scope: Daily bar approximation with prior-close sizing, next-open fills, lagged ADV participation cap, square-root impact, minimum commission, date-aware sell tax, board-based limit proxy, factor-aware lot mapping, T+1 and daily valuation. Not order-book matching, independent raw-price/corporate-action reconciliation, or broker paper trading.
known_data_limits: No independent historical ST or IPO price-limit reference feed
Corporate actions use Qlib adjusted-unit accounting, not a cash-dividend ledger
Open volume is not observed; lagged ADV capacity does not prove auction fills
Transfer fee is a conservative fixed assumption, not a full historical fee schedule
